errorCodes.meaning: No session record with this id in state `opened` or `presented`, in a context the caller may act in — including one that expired, was accepted, or was opened by vta/witness/open/0.1.
The document handed back is not the witness's witness/session/0.2 #response for this session: wrong type, issuer, recipient or thread, or a proof that does not verify for the witness's DID.
A credential bound to the session at open is no longer in the vault, or is no longer active.
A credential bound to the session at open has changed since, or has left its validity period.

CarriedDocument.description: A whole Trust Task document — `id`, `type`, `payload` and every other member, `proof` included — carried between the VTA and the witness by the client: one the VTA built and signed for the client to send, or one the witness returned for the client to hand back. Typed as an open object so every member survives a round trip: carried exactly as built or received, never re-serialised, because its proof is over itself. Its envelope is checked by the VTA against the session record (CONVENTIONS.md §3), not by this schema.
CarriedDocument.title: CarriedDocument

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

document.description: The witness/session/submit/0.2 document, on the session's thread, issued and signed by relationshipDid and addressed to the witness, carrying the relationship presentation in `vp` and, under the member link, the member presentation in `memberPresentation`. For the client to send from relationshipDid unaltered.

SessionId.description: The id of the witness/session document the VTA built in vta/witness/open: the session's name, the thread every document of the session is on, and the value the VWC carries as taskContext. The VTA keys its state for the session by it.

schema.description: A client hands its VTA the witness's answer to the session it opened; the VTA verifies that the answer is the witness's own, builds the presentations bound to its challenge and domain, and returns the witness/session/submit document, signed as the relationship DID, for the client to send.

response.description: The witness/session/0.2 #response the witness returned, exactly as received, under the witness's proof.
